name: storage-location
title: Storage Location
description: A physical location (such as a building, room, cabinet or drawer) within the holding institution where objects associated with the collection description are stored or exhibited.
rdfs:comment: A physical location (such as a building, room, cabinet or drawer) within the holding institution where objects associated with the collection description are stored or exhibited.

fields.name: storageLocation_pk
fields.title: Storage Location (Primary Key)
fields.description: A unique identifier for an ltc:StorageLocation.
fields.comments: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to guarantee uniqueness.
fields.rdfs:comment: A unique identifier for an ltc:StorageLocation.

fields.name: objectGroup_fk
fields.title: Object Group (Foreign Key)
fields.comments: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the (Primary Key).
fields.rdfs:comment: This property refers to one or more related instances of the StorageLocation class.

fields.name: parentStorageLocation_fk
fields.title: Storage Location (Foreign Key)
fields.comments: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the (Primary Key).
fields.rdfs:comment: This property refers to one or more related parent instances of the StorageLocation class.

fields.name: locationDescription
fields.title: Location Description
fields.description: Short textual description of the storage location of the group of items
fields.rdfs:comment: Short textual description of the storage location of the group of items

fields.name: locationName
fields.title: Location Name
fields.description: A label used to identify a place where the collection is stored.
fields.comments: This is the lowest level of storage location for the object group (collection or sub-collection).
fields.rdfs:comment: A label used to identify a place where the collection is stored.

fields.name: locationType
fields.title: Location Type
fields.description: The nature of the location where the collection is stored.
fields.comments: This defines the type of storage location named in locationName, and may refer to static locations or moveable containers.
fields.rdfs:comment: The nature of the location where the collection is stored.
